# OHADA MCP Server

> Public, read-only Model Context Protocol server for OHADA business law and SYSCOHADA. Designed for AI assistants, agents, developers and LegalTech applications that need traceable legal retrieval instead of unsupported model recall.

- Canonical documentation: https://christchad-mv.github.io/ohada-mcp-server/
- Source code: https://github.com/ChristChad-mv/ohada-mcp-server
- Public MCP endpoint: https://ohada-mcp-oa42gsj75q-ew.a.run.app/mcp
- Transport: Streamable HTTP
- Author: Christ Chadrak Mvoungou
- License: MIT
- Status: independent initiative; not affiliated with or officially approved by OHADA

## What OHADA MCP Server does

OHADA MCP Server exposes structured tools that allow an MCP-compatible client to:

- search OHADA legal provisions from a natural-language question or legal concept;
- retrieve the complete text, hierarchy, version and official-source metadata of a known article;
- retrieve several exact OHADA articles in one call;
- verify and normalize a legal citation;
- check the indexed provision against a requested date;
- search SYSCOHADA concepts and passages;
- retrieve complete SYSCOHADA passages or the indexed context of an exact account.

The server supplies legal retrieval tools and structured source data. The connected AI model or application remains responsible for producing the final synthesis.

## Public endpoint

```text
https://ohada-mcp-oa42gsj75q-ew.a.run.app/mcp
```

The `/mcp` path is a protocol endpoint, not a normal HTML page. A browser may show an error about `text/event-stream`; use an MCP-compatible client. Service health is available at:

```text
https://ohada-mcp-oa42gsj75q-ew.a.run.app/health
```

## OHADA legal tools

- `list_legal_texts`: list indexed legal texts and canonical codes.
- `search_ohada_law`: discover relevant provisions when the exact citation is unknown.
- `get_article`: retrieve one exact article with full text, hierarchy, version and source.
- `get_articles`: retrieve 2 to 5 exact articles in one call.
- `get_act`: return general metadata for an OHADA act.
- `get_version`: return the currently indexed version of a legal text.
- `get_provision_at_date`: check the indexed provision against a requested date.
- `verify_citation`: verify and normalize a supplied citation without repeating the full text.

## SYSCOHADA tools

- `search_syscohada`: discover accounting passages by concept, class or account.
- `get_syscohada_passages`: retrieve 1 to 5 complete passages discovered by search.
- `get_syscohada_account`: retrieve all indexed passages for an exact SYSCOHADA account.

## Recommended retrieval workflow

1. If the exact reference is already known, call `get_article`, `get_articles` or `get_syscohada_account` directly.
2. Otherwise discover candidates with `search_ohada_law` or `search_syscohada`.
3. Retrieve the complete selected content before composing the final answer.
4. Cite the legal-text code, article or account reference, indexed version and official-source metadata returned by the server.
5. Do not call `verify_citation` after a successful exact retrieval of the same reference.
6. Never invent a provision or case law that is absent from the indexed corpus.

## Current corpus

OHADA MCP Server currently indexes 13 OHADA legal texts plus the official SYSCOHADA publication. Coverage includes the revised OHADA Treaty, Uniform Acts and CCJA regulations documented at:

https://christchad-mv.github.io/ohada-mcp-server/corpus/

Current limitations:

- CCJA and national case law are not yet indexed;
- private doctrine and commentary are not indexed;
- the SYSCOHADA application guide is not indexed;
- exhaustive historical versions are not yet reconstructed.

## Legal and safety note

OHADA MCP Server is a documentary research tool, not legal advice. Generated answers should distinguish retrieved legal text from model interpretation and should be checked against the applicable version, official publication, relevant case law and professional advice when needed.
